criteria.A1: ablation: naive_switch makes > 0 false claims on stale items (the vouching is what removes them)
criteria.A2: ablation: vouch_only makes 0 false claims and its stale mean quality is below the hybrid's (the fallback is what restores function)
criteria.E1: reliable: hybrid loses to central_only on at most 1% of items, and makes 0 false claims there
criteria.E2a: stale: hybrid mean quality > central_only's, hybrid makes 0 false claims and central_only > 0
criteria.E2b: stale: hybrid wins more paired items than it loses against central_only
criteria.E3: all items: hybrid makes 0 false claims and fewer than central_only
criteria.E4: reliable: hybrid actions <= central_only's on every item and < local_only's on every item
criteria.E5: reported only: hybrid beats local_only on paired items overall and central_only on mean quality overall
